title: Subscription!
body:
I downloaded this amazing app just to write to the developer as well as the Apple editors.
For Apple: keep pushing subscription based apps will end up loosing customers such as me who own 5 macs, 4 iPhones and 2 iPads under my roof!
We don’t mind subscriptions for some valuable & needed apps & services BUT pushing the principle for every single app in every category!
I migrated from windows since 2010 and convinced my family, my parents and one of my sisters to do the same BUT some times I feel you try to push us away!
For the developer: You have a really great app all around BUT what you ask is too much! Every app cycle is 2 years and we may accept a one year cycle for individual developers within a reasonable price.
5$ is the value, in my opinion, for such app. In fact it’s ONLY for this good one. I might stretch it further for 10 if the cycle 2 years at least.

Apple: we are ready to go pack to pen and paper if you keep up the good work!

We pay too much for subscriptions of everything!!!

Thanks to the developers for their response. If still convinced with the subscription model, I suggest you consider “Setapp”. All the best with your good work.

title: Good. But subscription good? Not that much.
body:
I like the app, it has nice features with good UI. But a monthly subscription for a habit tracking  app features? 

It’s too much, there are no need for extensive servers or continuous innovation or even that much operations. I need it to remind me of habits, with a check & track. Why would i pay monthly for that?! What are the huge continuous monthly resources are being paid due to my use?

I unfortunately, though I’m happy to shed more than the yearly subscription for a one time purchase, deleted it and looked for a purchasable option. 

Many thanks.

UPDATE: thanks for your reply. What i meant is, for subscription-based apps I expect a continuous resources and benefits. I’m subscribing in services from 10$ upto 200$, no problem, but i know there is a continuous benefits, rather than just using the same asset which is powered also by my phones’ CPU.

I don’t mind paying 10-20$ for this app, but it doesn’t make sense to me to pay monthly to rent this app where there is many do the same. And there’s limitations in how innovative the market can be.
